bio: One of those situations in which a restaurant has reinvented itself along with the careers of the couple at the helm. Here, José Vicente has given a new lease of life to the original family-run bar, while María abandoned her job as a biologist to give free rein to her true passion. In this bright eatery, featuring a large glass-fronted wine cellar and a meticulous interior, choose between an interesting à la carte and a set menu that showcases the recipes of the Alto Palancia area (l’Alt Palància). These range from delicious, updated takes on traditional recipes to bolder creations inspired from further afield (the Vietnamese vegetable nem and the flavours of the fritters made with a brandade of cauliflower and sriracha came as a pleasant surprise).
